values.note: 'NO RESERVATIONS TAKEN' (township page title); 'Payment in full and registration is required prior to total set up.' Check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: http://www.stannardtwp.com/rv_park_information.php (page heading 'RV Park Information - NO RESERVATIONS TAKEN') + http://www.stannardtwp.com/parks/rv_park.php (campground rules adopted 10-8-2018), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: Dump station: township campground rules ('CAMPGROUND RULES ARE POSTED ON THE BULLETIN BOARD BY THE DUMP STATION'), http://www.stannardtwp.com/parks/rv_park.php. Showers: Google Maps review by Pat Carver, about 2025 ('$3 to shower'); the township says nothing about them. Read 2026-10-25.

hookups.source: Google Maps reviews of 'Stannard Township RV Campground' (Pat Carver, about 2025: 'the only spot available had the 30amp outlet'; Kate Geisen, about 2023: '$15/night for electric and water hookup'); the township's pages give no hookup details. Read 2026-10-25.

sites.source: Google Maps reviews, about 2023 (Bernadette DeVries: '12 level, pull thru sites'; Kate Geisen: 'There are 8 first-come, first serve sites'), read 2026-10-25. The township states no count or length; the derived 12 sites (the reviews disagree, 8 vs 12) and 40-ft maximum (a reviewer's own rig is never a limit) are cleared.

note: Township-run RV park on US-45 in Bruce Crossing (14190 US-45), operated by Stannard Township (local government; RV Life mislabels as commercial). Gravel pads beside a strip of grass in an open field by the road (road noise); utilities are shared between pairs of sites, so neighbours park facing opposite ways; honor-system payment. Google reviewers report $15 a night (2025) and some RVs staying long-term. Open ~May 15-Oct 31. --Claude
summary: Township site is live but its RV park pages hold only the 2018 rules and the 'NO RESERVATIONS TAKEN' heading: confirmed FCFS and the dump station. Everything else rests on Google reviews (listing open, 4.2 stars, 43 reviews, phone (906) 827-3778): hookups/showers/pull-through marked reported; cleared the derived 12-site count (reviews say 8 or 12) and the 40-ft max. No township rate or season (public park; Google ladder met). Note trimmed of field facts, review-sourced items attributed.
